mapper.select:
SELECT FROM log_info WHERE deleted = 0
AND account = #{req.account}
AND (action_time BETWEEN to_timestamp(#{req.operateStartTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:MS') AND to_timestamp(#{req.operateEndTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:MS'))
ORDER BY action_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_info ( date_ym, title, descr, type, uid, account, action_time, spent, method, name, pack, url, session, mobile, ip, os, browser, engine, record, param, result, exception, app ) VALUES ( #{entity.dateYm}, #{entity.title}, #{entity.descr}, #{entity.type}, #{entity.uid}, #{entity.account},#{entity.actionTime}, #{entity.spent}, #{entity.method}, #{entity.name}, #{entity.pack}, #{entity.url}, #{entity.session}, #{entity.mobile}, #{entity.ip},#{entity.os}, #{entity.browser}, #{entity.engine}, #{entity.record}, #{entity.param}, #{entity.result}, #{entity.exception}, #{entity.app} )
